CEYLON ELECTRICITY BOARD ACT, No. 17 OF 1969
Order under Section 57

BY virtue of powers vested in me by Section 57 of the Ceylon Electricity Board Act, No. 17 of 1969, I, RanjithSiyambalapitiya, Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, do by this order, approve the proposed acquisition of landsrequired to the Ceylon Electricity Board described in the Schedule hereto.
RANJITH SIYAMBALAPITIYA,Minister of Power and Renewable Energy.
18th October 2018.
SCHEDULE

Boundaries of land depicted in the Plan No. BHP- 06 dated 26.09.2018, prepared by the Ceylon Electricity Board asLot No. A, with the land extents 0.891 Hectares situated in Morahenagama village, Dagampitiya Grama Niladhari DivisionNo. 316/ F, of Ambagamuwa Divisional Secretary's Division of Ambagamuwa Korale of Nuwaraeliya administrative districtof the Central Province of the land of Sri Lanka, as described in the Schedule hereto :
01. Lot No. A - The land in extent of 0.891 Hectares
North:Kehelgamu Oya and Ceylon Electricity Board Land ;East:Kehelgamu Oya and Ceylon Electricity Board Land ;South:Ceylon Electricity Board Land;West:Ceylon Electricity Board Land.
Claimed by:G.. M. Heenmenike.

CEYLON ELECTRICITY BOARD ACT, No. 17 OF 1969
Order under Section 57

BY virtue of powers vested in me by Section 57 of the Ceylon Electricity Board Act, No. 17 of 1969, I, RanjithSiyambalapitiya, Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, do by this order, approve the proposed acquisition of landsrequired by the Ceylon Electricity Board, described in the Schedule hereto.

Schedule

Boundaries of lands respectively 3.7757 hectares and 4.9286 hectares in extent, depicted as Lot A and Lot B, in theSurvey Plan No. BHP- 05 dated 04.09.2018, prepared by the Ceylon Electricity Board situated in Millagahamula village,of Grama Niladhari Division No. 316/ E, and Pitawala Village of Grama Niladhari Division No. 316/ D, of AmbagamuwaDivisional Secretary's Division of Ambagamuwa Korale of Nuwaraeliya administrative district of the Central Provinceof the land of Sri Lanka, as described in the Schedule hereto :
01. Lot No. A - The land in extent of 3.7757 Hectares
North:Main Road ;East:Delpath Oya;South:Kelani River and Delpath Oya;West:Rambukpath Oya.
Land ownership : Not known.
02. Lot No. B - The land in extent of 4.9286 Hectares
North:Delpath Oya and Main road ;East:Main Road and the boundary up to the Kelani River from the 11th k.m. Post;South:Kelani River ;West:Delpath Oya .
